name: Multi-Mode Rendering with Iso-surfaces and Meshes
aliases: Hybrid Ray Tracing for Iso-surfaces and Meshes
definition: A rendering mode supporting volume data, implicit iso-surfaces, and triangle meshes, using separate BVHs and hardware-accelerated intersection tests.
summary: Multi-Mode Rendering combines hardware-accelerated ray-triangle intersection with volume ray marching to efficiently integrate density up to the nearest mesh or isosurface hit.
